propositions: Bug tickets must capture which detection channel (canary, CI, review-bot, agent, human-audit, user-report) identified them at creation time to enable escape-channel trend analysis.

The detected_by field is sourced from REBAR_DETECTED_BY environment variable at the create_core seam, with an optional --detected-by CLI flag taking precedence, and must apply uniformly across library, MCP, and CLI creation paths.
The detected_by value is normalized via strip() and lowercase, with empty/whitespace treated as unset, unknown tokens stamped verbatim without enum validation, and create never failing on the value.
The detected_by field must project into compiled state present-only in process_create (mirroring source_* blocks) such that events without it reduce byte-identically to pre-change behavior.

Jira inbound CREATE events (via apply_inbound_records.py) intentionally bypass create_core and receive no detected_by stamp to avoid mis-attributing reconciler daemon origin to human-authored Jira tickets.
